|game_text='''0 side — Watch Your Step'''

Deploy Cantina, Docking Bay 94, and Tatooine system. '''For''' remainder of game, opponent activates no Force at your Cantina. Your cards with ability are deploy +6 except Luke, smugglers, freighters, and [Independent] starships. Opponent's game text on Kessel system is canceled. '''While''' this side up, once during each of your deploy phases, may take Corellia or Kessel into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. '''Flip''' this card if you occupy two battlegrounds with smugglers or have completed two Kessel Runs.

'''7 side — This Place Can Be A Little Rough'''

'''While''' this side up, your Force generation is +1 at each system you control with a smuggler. Opponent's Force generation at non-battlegrounds is limited to 1. When you have two or more smugglers in a battle, add one battle destiny. Each of your smugglers is forfeit +2. Once during each turn, may play one interrupt from Lost Pile as if from hand (then place that card out of play). Sense, Alter, and Keep Your Eyes Open may not be played. '''Flip''' this card if you do not occupy two battlegrounds (unless you have completed two Kessel Runs).

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Ref2-L-thisplacecanbealittlerough-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]: The game text changes: “as if from hand” is added after “from Lost Pile”. The slip shows only the lower part of the card and adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•This Place Can Be A Little Rough” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
